capabilities: Apply one of 9 built-in background color presets to PDF pages
Add pattern overlays (dot, grid, line, stripe, etc.) with adjustable spacing, size, color, and opacity
Create, edit, and delete custom color and pattern templates in settings
Switch presets and templates from a sidebar panel with reset and settings shortcuts
extras: Not yet available in the Obsidian community plugin directory (listed as coming soon); requires Obsidian 1.13.0+; works offline with no network requests or telemetry; README includes a comparison table against PDF++, Theme Quick Switch, and CSS snippets.
intentEvidence: While you can tweak PDF background colors with CSS snippets or the PDF++ plugin, both require technical know-how
motivation: The author built it to make PDF reading comfortable without CSS knowledge, since CSS snippets and PDF++ both require technical know-how and support only solid colors.
problem: Obsidian's PDF viewer renders pages on a bright white canvas, causing eye strain during long reading sessions, and existing CSS or plugin workarounds require technical knowledge and only support solid colors.

relations.evidence: tweak PDF background colors with CSS snippets or the PDF++ plugin, both require technical know-how
Inspired by the PaperCraft plugin's template management pattern and texture design.

summary: PDF reading tint plugin that changes PDF page background color with presets, pattern overlays, and custom templates, no CSS required.
